ocl:
context CheckIn
inv: self.isOnline implies self.boardingPass <> null

context BoardingPass
inv: ((self.seat <> null) and (self.seat.oclIsTypeOf(Seat))) and (self.checkIn.booking.createdAt <> '')

context BoardingPass
inv: (self.seat <> null) and (self.gate <> null)

context Baggage
inv: self.weightKg >= 4 and self.weightKg <= 56

context Aircraft
inv: self.seats->size() >= 1 and self.seats->size() <= 3

context Aircraft
inv: self.seats->size() >= 2 and self.seats->size() <= 2

context Airline
inv: self.flights->size() >= 1 and self.flights->size() <= 1

context Airline
inv: self.aircrafts->size() >= 3 and self.aircrafts->size() <= 3

context Aircraft
inv: (self.seats->any(x | x.seatNo <> '') <> null) and (self.airline.oclIsTypeOf(Airline))

context Airport
inv: (self.arrivingFlights->one(x | x.departureTime <> '')) and (self.city.size() >= 5 implies self.city.substring(1, 5) = 'AB')

context Booking
inv: (self.baggages->collect(x | x.weightKg)->notEmpty()) and (self.bookingRef <> '' and self.bookingRef.size() > 0)

context Flight
inv: self.arrivalTime <> null and self.departureTime <> null

context Flight
inv: self.departureTime <> null and self.arrivalTime <> null

context Airport
inv: (self.arrivingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()) and (not(self.arrivingFlights->collect(x | x.bookings)->flatten()->notEmpty()))

context Flight
inv: ((self.arrivalTime <> '') and (self.bookings->forAll(v | v.bookingRef <> ''))) and (self.bookings->exists(v | not(v.bookingRef <> '')))

context Aircraft
inv: ((self.registrationNo <> '') and (self.seats->forAll(v | v.seatNo <> ''))) and (self.seats->exists(v | not(v.seatNo <> '')))

context BoardingPass
inv: ((self.seat <> null) and (self.barcode.size() >= 19)) and (not((self.seat <> null) and (self.barcode.size() >= 19)))

context Flight
inv: (self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null) and (not(self.departureTime <> null implies self.arrivalTime <> null))

context Flight
inv: (self.arrivalTime <> null implies self.departureTime <> null) and (not(self.arrivalTime <> null implies self.departureTime <> null))

context Booking
inv: ((self.createdAt <> '') and (self.baggages->forAll(v | v.weightKg <= 100))) and (self.baggages->exists(v | not(v.weightKg <= 100)))

context Airline
inv: ((self.flights->collect(x | x.bookings)->size() >= 3) and (self.aircrafts->notEmpty())) and (not((self.flights->collect(x | x.bookings)->size() >= 3) and (self.aircrafts->notEmpty())))

context Airline
inv: (self.flights->forAll(x | x.departureTime <> '')) and (self.flights->exists(x | not(x.departureTime <> '')))

context Airline
inv: ((self.aircrafts->one(x | x.registrationNo <> '')) and (self.flights->size() >= 2 and self.flights->size() <= 3)) and (self.flights->size() < 2)

context Passenger
inv: (self.bookings->exists(x | x.bookingRef <> '')) and (not(self.bookings->exists(x | x.bookingRef <> '')))

context Seat
inv: ((self.aircraft.airline.code <> '') and (self.seatNo.size() = 19)) and (not((self.aircraft.airline.code <> '') and (self.seatNo.size() = 19)))

context Airline
inv: ((self.aircrafts->collect(x | x.model)->notEmpty()) and (self.name.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not((self.aircrafts->collect(x | x.model)->notEmpty()) and (self.name.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))
